Subject: release near Laval
Compliance Team,
I'm emailing about a release I was told about while out patrolling the pipeline near Laval,
Quebec on May 4th around 15:00. A member of the public reported it. We're looking into it
now.
From what I've gathered so far, gasoline was released and it got onto the pipeline right of
way. It also got off the right of way onto neighbouring land. I'm not sure what caused the
release.
I'll keep you updated as I get more info.
Sylvain Laforest, Pipeline Patrol Contractor
